verdict.rationale: Xero documents AI-assisted bill capture (upload/email extraction to draft bills) and batch payment scheduling/export to pay multiple bills at once, covering capture and payment ends of the workflow. However, evidence only vaguely mentions bills being 'ready for approval' without detailing a structured approval-routing workflow (multi-step approvals, approver assignment, notifications). Missing for 10: explicit approval-routing/workflow documentation, evidence of multi-user approval chains, and independent corroboration of the end-to-end capture-approve-pay flow.
